publishedfiledetails.title: 45 Inventory Slots [Fixed + EquipSlot UI expand] 整合版
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h2][b]This update includes:[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]*20240506 v1.1.5.2b[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Added:[/b] ENABLEINTERSEP. When off, all slots have equal horizontal spacing.
[*][b]Fixed:[/b] Backpack Merge Mode: After selecting this mode, the backpack now defaults to it after manual operation. Activating merge mode automatically adjusts the inventory bar  to three rows.
    ⚠️[i][u]NOTICE If the backpack is too large, a warning will be displayed. Excess slots may extend beyond the intended display range, which cannot be directly resolved at present.[/u][/i]
[*][b]Compatibility:[/b] Multivariate Certificate of Functional Medal mod now automatically adjust to the correct position.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
This version with 45 inventory slots is based on the code from two other mods, with 99.99% of the code coming from the following two sources:
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2801880191]45 Inventory Slots [Fixed][/url] — The implementation of the main functionalities is mostly derived from this version.
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2906717350]45 Inventory Slots [EquipSlot UI expand][/url] — UI-related code and compatibility issues related to the display of the six-item equipment slot.
This hybrid inherits the advantages of both mods and is designed to be compatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2484725102]Upgradable Chest[/url], addressing issues that arise when both mods are activated simultaneously, such as the single-line display problem , and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2798599672]Extra Equip Slots+1/2/3[/url] The mod has been hidden and cannot be subscribed to anymore.  You can use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2950481491]Extra Equip Slots+1/2/3 (Tell me what you want)[/url] as a replacement for the this mod. 

[h3]Key improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Basically fixed some strange bug affecting 45 slots, such as lightning issue , rollback causes duplication of cow, Wilson's beard crashes, misalignment of sea fishing rods, and equip something abnormal inside chests.
[*]the UI has been enlarged to accommodate [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2950481491]Extra Equip Slots+1/2/3 (Tell me what you want)[/url] , [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1909182187]能力勋章 Functional Medal[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2484725102]Upgradable Chest[/url], compatibility. Fixed issues causing single-line display problems when both are enabled have been fixed.
[*] Supported to set the top row as the first row, prioritizing item filling.
[*] Fixed for display issues with Functional Medal's Multivariate Certificate.
[*] Support for backpack merge mode.
[/list]

[h3]Credit goes to the original authors. If there is any infringement, it will be promptly addressed and deleted.[/h3]

Below is the info file content for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2801880191]45 Inventory Slots [Fixed][/url] version 1.1.5:
[quote=Antaeogo]
45 Inventory Slots mod updated to work with the lastest updates,
such as the WX and Maxwell Reworks.

Credits to Sanggiyan and the previous authors.

v1.1.4 Changes:
 - Crash fix attempt (beard sack)
 
 （v1.1.5
- Craft with ingredients from open containers）
[/quote]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2906717350]45 Inventory Slots [EquipSlot UI expand][/url] version 1.2:
[quote=logan] 
Expand the UI of the 45-slot inventory to accommodate various mods that add equipment slots, preventing the UI from being obscured.
When used with the Functional Medal mod, please open the Functional Medal mod settings interface and disable "Automatically stick the medal bar to the edge" to ensure that the merged medal can be opened normally.
[/quote]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Revision Modification update log:[/h2]
[h3][b]*2023-10-24 Modification:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Added "priority = 0.01" to the info file to address compatibility issues with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2484725102]Upgradable Chest[/url] and resolve the single-line display problem.
[*]Based on insights from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2906717350]45 Inventory Slots [EquipSlot UI expand][/url], fixed UI display issues related to the ability medals (1909182187). Compatibility with the six-item equipment slot was improved, and relevant UI components were transferred to this mod to prevent overlap issues in the original mod.
[/list]
[h3][b]*2023-11-07 FIXED Version (Mod Update 1.1.5):[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Revisited and made further modifications to address any issues and improve the overall functionality of the mod.
[/list]
[h3][b]*2023-11-29 Version 1.1.5.1[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the positioning logic of grid placement to ensure equal sizes on the left and right sides of the HUB.
[*]Revised the logic for the appearance of grid separation gaps to prevent misalignment and irregularities caused by mismatched gap positions between the upper and lower rows of grids.
[*]Introduced a new First slot setting option: determine which slot in the inventory serves as the first slot. Picked-up items will start from this slot and be stored in corresponding slots from left to right. Once a row is filled, the items will be stored in the next row in the same sequence. By default, you can use shortcut keys 1-9, 0 to quickly use items in the corresponding slots.
    This mod provides two options: the top-left slot and the bottom-left slot, with the default considering the bottom-left slot as the first slot (consistent with other 45-slot mods).
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
*If you encounter an extended startup delay when using this mod for the first time, follow these steps for troubleshooting:*

1. *Check if you have any other mods enabled that involve the six-item equipment slot or similar features. If so, try the following:*
   - *Disable the equipment slot mod.*
   - *Simultaneously, adjust the "Enable extra equipment slots" option in this mod to "Backpack & Amulets."*

2. *Launch the game and wait for it to start up normally. After a successful launch, exit the game.*

3. *Adjust the “Enable extra equipment slots” option in this mod to “None” and enable the equipment slot mod again.*

publishedfiledetails.title: 45 Inventory Slots [Fixed + EquipSlot UI expand + Shift+Click support]
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This mod is created based on: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3075429483

99% of the work and credits goes to original authors.
This is the only fully patched version on workshop to fix annoying problem with Shift + Click feature.

In original version of this mod, there was a problem when moving any food item / normal item from main inventory to let's say Crock pot / chest using Shift + Left mouse button (to cook food faster because why not?).

Instead it always moved that specific item to equipped and opened backpack ...and then you had to move it from backpack to crockpot or any chest which is ughhhhh...

Of course same issue applied in reversed direction - from Fridge / crockpot to backpack instead to main inventory.
My patch fixes all that and it works with any other vanilla / modded containers like Saltbox, Fridge, Magician's chest, Big chest, DST freezer etc..

Version v1.1.7 - Fixed stacking in backpack for all kind of scenarios, added compatibility with DJ'Paul's Sorting Inventory mod - My version on workshop coming soon too! :)

Version v1.1.6a - Compatibility with other modded containers for Shift + Click feature, 
I made a mistake in earlier version and it didn't work for basic fridge and chests, now it's fixed!

Version v1.1.5.5 - Fixed infinite loading screen on dedicated servers

Version v1.1.5.4a - Fixed sorting in inventory based on chosed config options. Optimized code for better performance

Version v1.1.5.3b - Fixed freezes on relaunching existing world with mod turned on

Version v1.1.5.3a - Initial and patched version - see the whole description

publishedfiledetails.title: 7+ Equip Slots Fix
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
A fix for the limit on the number of Equip Slots for the clients (raised from 7 to 63. The hosts do not have this limitation).

I made this so people are able to use my Archery Mod in combination with other mods which would add more Equip Slots and go above the limit of 7 Equip Slots, currently imposed by Klei, after which items behave in an upredicted way.

To make things clear : It is not a fix for the visual glitch of the equipslots going outside of the inventory bar! This fixes the deserialization issue which occurs for all equippable items when having more than 7 equip slots. If you do not use my other mods (for example), which add complex items not using regular components from the base game (like "weapon", ...), you probably never noticed the issue and do not need this mod.

publishedfiledetails.title: extra-equip-slot-eqs
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
为人物添加额外的服装栏、护符栏、背包栏。
已兼容 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1909182187] [u] 能力勋章 Functional Medal [/u][/url]
已兼容 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2526778484] [u] 虚空异界（泰拉） [/u][/url]
已兼容 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3075429483] [u] 45 Inventory Slots [Fixed + EquipSlot UI expand] 整合版 [/u][/url]

说明：
1、因为是在原版3格的基础上额外添加的格子（4/5/6格），所以只有部分物品会分配到新装备栏，没有分配的会按照原有继续装备在第2格。
2、给每个格子加了设置，你可以任意开关这三个格子（不支持调整顺序，这个需求应该不大吧）。
3、新增智能识别背包栏、智能识别护符栏（识别力度很苛刻，所以部分模组物品可能没有顾及到）。
4、第二个格子留给护甲，这样的好处是能够适配绝大部分模组物品。（应该没有几个模组会做一个没有防御的衣服吧）
5、部分物品异常的被正确识别，比如精灵公主的海盗箱子会被认为是背包、魔法猫咪可以正常装备到护符栏。（这些模组我都没有进行额外适配，原因不明，可能是模组本身声明了装备标签类型。反正挺好用的就是）~哈哈哈。。尴尬

注意：
1、护甲、服装、护符，按照装备先后顺序后装备的优先显示。（同时显示暂不支持）
2、融合背包栏箭头显示会偏离，（建议使用正常的背包栏，尽力了，能力有限）。
3、本模组加载优先级为-1，意味着基本晚于所有现有模组。好处就是比如你加载了例如：能力勋章模组，该模组会优先增加一个专属装备栏，然后才会加载剩余的背包、护符等栏。这样可以极大的避免模组弹出的格子ui对不齐的问题。

其他：
1、棱镜-子圭釜 默认会被强制调整为原身体栏（护甲栏），极大的保证不影响平衡。按需可以在设置项中进行调节。
2、棱镜-皇帝的披风 不主动适配 会装备在背包栏 因为它作用的是背包栏物品。（会隐藏背包）。极大的保证了棱镜中的幻化功能。
3、海洋传说-雨花·扶风 不主动适配（会影响原有套装属性 按需可以在设置项中进行调节）。
4、Gawr Gura-游泳圈 不适配 （调整到服装栏会丢失原人物游泳特性）。
5、鸢一折纸 不适配（绝灭天使 和 救世魔王 两个物品会有兼容性问题 ）。
6、更多物品-暗夜空间斗篷 不适配 （会丢失闪避效果）。

欢迎大家加群反馈建议和寻求帮助。
璇儿群聊 714580460
海洋传说群聊 749774620
武器成长群聊 947534732

如本模组依然不能正常使用，请尝试社区同类模组 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2324689937] [u] More equip slots [/u][/url] 。

以下是本模组源码地址（部分借鉴代码均在源码有注释出处 致谢所有）：
[url=https://github.com/Breathe97/extra-equip-slot-eqs][u] extra-equip-slot-eqs [/u][/url] 

对了 如果你想要饥荒全套屏幕加载壁纸的话请来这里 [url=https://www.bilibili.com/read/cv24416343/?spm_id_from=333.999.0.0] [u] 【饥荒：联机版】加载屏幕 壁纸 [/u][/url]

publishedfiledetails.title: Save Equipment Slots
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]No more updates planned[/h1]
This mod will no longer receive updates. 
Only when a critical bug arises I will attempt to fix it.

-----------

Saves the inventory slots of equipment items and makes sure they always return to their saved slot. 
If a saved slot is occupied items will be rearranged automatically to make space.

[h1]Don't Starve[/h1]
This mod originally released for Don't Starve and all its expansions, and has since been updated to also support DST.
You can find the Don't Starve version [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1591337941]here[/url].

[h1]Clear Slots with Controller [/h1]
To clear a saved slot with a controller press LB + RB at the same time in the inventory management screen when highlighting the slot. 

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
See the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/changelog/1598084686]Change Notes[/url].

The DST version starts at v1.2.0. Versions prior to that were Don't Starve only.

[h1]Master Simulation & Client Mode[/h1]
This mod runs in one of 2 fundamentally different modes depending on the scenario:
[list]
[*] [b]Master Simulation[/b] - This is when you host the game rather than connect to some other host. In this scenario your game has full control over the inventory, and this mod will run pretty much like it did in the original Don't Starve version.
[*] [b]Client Mode[/b] - Whenever you connect to some other host this mod will run in "Client Mode". This also happens when you are the host but have Caves enabled, as this spawns another server on your machine and your game connects to it. In this mode, you have far less control over the inventory, as all components including the inventory are managed on the host server. Much of the logic had to be implemented in a different way, but this has been done and the modes should behave mostly the same. Below is a list of the limitations in Client Mode.
[/list]

[h1]Client Mode limitations[/h1]
Below are some things that work differently in Client Mode as we do not have full control like when we run the Master Simulation.
[list]
[*] Saved slots will not be restored when loading a saved game and have to be reassigned.
[list]
[*] Note: As of v1.8.2 we will save all current items to their current slots when your character is spawned which should mostly fix this issue. It means sometimes when reloading a game or traveling to caves and back items may be saved to the wrong slot but many times it will be correct. This behavior can be turned off in options.
[/list]
[*] Animations of picked up items will target their original slot as we operate after an item was put in a slot rather than before like in Master Simulation.
[*] Some delay due to communicating with server, no different than normal play.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] None
[/list]

If you run into anything please let me know :)

[h1]Configuration[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Apply To Items[/b]: allows you to save slots of more than just equipment.
[list]
[*] Equipment (default)
[*] Equipment + Food
[*] Equipment + Healing (e.g. Healing Salve, Spider Gland)
[*] Equipment + Food + Healing
[*] All Items (every item in the game)
[/list]
[*] [b]Show Slot Icons[/b]: When enabled (default), renders icons of assigned items above their inventory slots.
[*] [b]Slot Icon Opacity[/b]: Sets the opacity of the slot icons. Default is 75%.
[*] [b]Slot Icon Scale[/b]: Sets the scale of the slot icons. Default is 75%.
[*] [b]Slot Icon Vertical Offset[/b]: Increases the vertical offset between the slot icons and their inventory slot. Only added for users of mods that add additional rows of inventory slots (e.g. "60 inventory slots"). Otherwise you probably want to leave it at Default (= right above their inventory slot).
[*] [b]Disable Save Slots Toggle[/b]: Key combination that will toggle saving slots on/off. When off, picking up items or moving them will not assign/change their slots. This is useful when you only want to save item slots in some scenarios, or only want to save a few specific items and not everything.
[list]
[*] - none - (default)
[*] Control + A through Control + Z
[/list]
Please note the hotkey you configure could be in use by the game or another mod as well. Make sure to pick an available one.
[*] [b]Save Slots Initial State[/b]: The initial state of the save slots behavior (default: On). Only used when a toggle key is configured. If you prefer to by default not save any items, you can set this to Off so you have explicitly turn it On first when you want to use it.
[*] [b]Disable Slot Icon Click[/b]: Controls when to disable the slot icon click action which would clear an item's saved slot:
[list]
[*] Never (default): You can always click on a slot icon to clear the item's slot
[*] If Save Slots: Off: When Save Slots is toggled off the slot icon click will be disabled.
[/list]
[*] [b]Allow Equip For Space[/b]: When enabled (default), this mod is allowed to equip an item to make space for another item. In practice this would only occur when multiple items share a single slot and the slot is blocked. In other cases a blocking item is simply moved to some other slot.
[*] [b]Reserve Saved Slots[/b]: Controls whether or not slots that have an assigned item will be reserved for their saved items only. This means other items will not be placed there unless done manually by the player:
[list]
[*] Never (default): Saved slots will never be reserved for their items. This means other items can occupy a saved slot, but will be moved out of the way when a saved item can go there.
[*] If Free Slots: Saved slots will only be reserved for their items while there are other free slots available in inventory or backpack.
[*] Always: Saved slots will always be reserved for their items. It means saved slots are considered "full" whenever other items are picked up, so will either be empty or contain one of their saved items.
[/list]
[*] [b]DST: Save Items on Spawn[/b]: When enabled (default), the slots of all current items in the inventory will be saved when you are spawned. This helps to restore saved slots when an old game is resumed or when traveling back and forth between Caves. Without this option, all saved slots will be cleared because we cannot save any state on the server. This option respects the "Apply To Items" configuration option, so only items that would otherwise be saved will be saved on spawn. This includes the initial spawn.
[/list]
